response.title: Union calls Kolhapur bandh on 22 September
response.content:
The Kolhapur District Sugarcane Growers' Union has called for a Kolhapur bandh on 22 September 2026 to press for a higher cane price.

Union leaders said shops, markets and road traffic on the Pune-Bengaluru highway near Kolhapur would be affected if the bandh went ahead.

response.title: Kolhapur bandh called off
response.content:
The Kolhapur bandh called for 22 September 2026 has been called off after talks with the district administration, the union said on Monday.

Traffic on the highway near Kolhapur and markets in the city are expected to run normally on 22 September.
